concepts.gloss_en: The verse (Deut. 33:18) "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out" — cited as the archetype of commerce/business (masa u-matan) and the rectification of the craving for money

members.note: representative; full verse quote from Deut. 33
same verse quoted in truncated/defective form in lm1:23; identical referent (Zebulun's commerce → tikkun of money-craving), pure truncation variant
